page.title: カンマの注釈とwhereの場所案内

analysis.summaryJa: カンマ付きwho・which・whoseが対象を絞らず補足を加える働きと、whereが場所名詞から節内の場所の空所を結ぶ仕組みを、業務文脈で確認する。
grammarPoints: カンマ付き関係節は特定済みの人・物への追加情報を表す。
カンマの後ろではthatを使わず、人はwho、物はwhichを使う。
whereはplace where＋主語＋動詞の形で『そこで』を補う。
whoseはカンマ付き節でも所有関係を表せる。
visualEvidence: 赤いカンマの休憩所からwho・whichの注釈カードが横に伸びる。
場所名詞からWHEREの地図ピンが節内の場所の空所へ向かう。
commonTraps: 場所名詞だから常にwhereと考え、節内で主語・目的語が欠けている場合もwhereを選ぶ。
目的格whichの後ろにitを重ねる。

questions.prompt: The Osaka branch, ------- opened in April, now handles western-region accounts.

choices.A: that
choices.B: where
choices.C: which
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: 4月に開設された大阪支店は、現在西日本地域の取引先を担当しています。
questions.explanationJa: カンマ付きで物branchへの補足を加え、openedの主語になるwhichを使います。

questions.prompt: Ms. Ortega, ------- manages international shipments, will lead the briefing.

choices.A: who
choices.B: that
choices.C: which
choices.D: whom

questions.translationJa: 国際配送を管理するオルテガさんが説明会を主導します。
questions.explanationJa: 人へのカンマ付き補足で、managesの主語になるwhoが必要です。

questions.prompt: The renovated lobby, ------- visitors can charge their phones, opens tomorrow.

choices.A: which
choices.B: that
choices.C: who
choices.D: where

questions.translationJa: 来訪者が携帯電話を充電できる改装済みロビーは明日オープンします。
questions.explanationJa: lobbyという場所で行う動作を表すためwhereを使います。後続節は主語・動詞・目的語がそろっています。

questions.prompt: Our warehouse in Nagoya, ------- stores fragile equipment, has added a second loading bay.

choices.A: that
choices.B: which
choices.C: where
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: 壊れやすい機器を保管する名古屋の倉庫に、2番目の積み込み場が増設されました。
questions.explanationJa: 固有の倉庫への追加説明なので、カンマ後はthatではなくwhichを使います。

questions.prompt: The customer service center ------- overnight staff work is on the third floor.

choices.A: where
choices.B: which
choices.C: who
choices.D: what

questions.translationJa: 夜勤スタッフが働くカスタマーサービスセンターは3階にあります。
questions.explanationJa: workの場所を示す空所なのでwhereが適切です。

questions.prompt: Mr. Chen, ------- office is beside the conference hall, can issue visitor badges.

choices.A: who
choices.B: which
choices.C: whose
choices.D: that

questions.translationJa: 会議ホールの隣に事務室があるチェンさんは、来客用バッジを発行できます。
questions.explanationJa: officeの所有者がMr. Chenなのでwhoseを使います。カンマ付きでもwhoseは使用できます。

questions.prompt: The Riverside Hotel, ------- our annual seminar will be held, offers free airport transfers.

choices.A: which
choices.B: where
choices.C: that
choices.D: what

questions.translationJa: 年次セミナーが開かれるリバーサイドホテルは、空港送迎を無料で提供します。
questions.explanationJa: will be heldの場所を表すためwhereを選びます。

questions.prompt: The updated invoice, ------- I attached to this message, includes the service charge.

choices.A: that
choices.B: where
choices.C: who
choices.D: which

questions.translationJa: このメールに添付した更新済み請求書にはサービス料が含まれています。
questions.explanationJa: カンマ付き補足でinvoiceをattachedの目的語として受けるwhichが必要です。

questions.prompt: The testing room ------- technicians must wear protective glasses is temporarily closed.

choices.A: which
choices.B: who
choices.C: where
choices.D: whose

questions.translationJa: 技術者が保護眼鏡を着用しなければならない試験室は一時閉鎖中です。
questions.explanationJa: must wearの場所を示す副詞的な空所なのでwhereです。

questions.prompt: The delivery van, ------- was inspected yesterday, is ready for the morning route.

choices.A: which
choices.B: that
choices.C: where
choices.D: whom

questions.translationJa: 昨日点検された配送車は、朝のルートに出られる状態です。
questions.explanationJa: カンマ付きで物vanへの補足を加え、was inspectedの主語になるwhichを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a department head.

choices.A: Ms. Sato, that oversees procurement, is attending the supplier meeting.
choices.B: Ms. Sato, who oversees procurement, is attending the supplier meeting.
choices.C: Ms. Sato who, oversees procurement, is attending the supplier meeting.
choices.D: Ms. Sato, who she oversees procurement, is attending the supplier meeting.

questions.translationJa: 調達を統括する佐藤さんは仕入先会議に出席しています。
questions.explanationJa: 固有名詞への補足はカンマで囲み、人を受けるwhoを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a training venue.

choices.A: This is the room which new employees receive safety training.
choices.B: This is the room where new employees receive safety training there.
choices.C: This is the room who new employees receive safety training.
choices.D: This is the room where new employees receive safety training.

questions.translationJa: ここが新入社員が安全研修を受ける部屋です。
questions.explanationJa: room内で研修を受けるためwhereを使い、thereは重ねません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a software update.

choices.A: Version 4.2, which was released on Monday, fixes the login issue.
choices.B: Version 4.2, that was released on Monday, fixes the login issue.
choices.C: Version 4.2 which was released, on Monday fixes the login issue.
choices.D: Version 4.2, which it was released on Monday, fixes the login issue.

questions.translationJa: 月曜日に公開されたバージョン4.2は、ログイン問題を修正します。
questions.explanationJa: 特定済みの版への注釈なので、カンマ＋whichを用います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a hotel.

choices.A: The hotel which we stayed during the conference provides breakfast.
choices.B: The hotel where we stayed there during the conference provides breakfast.
choices.C: The hotel where we stayed during the conference provides breakfast.
choices.D: The hotel who we stayed during the conference provides breakfast.

questions.translationJa: 会議中に私たちが宿泊したホテルでは朝食が提供されます。
questions.explanationJa: stayは場所を直接目的語に取らないため、場所を表すwhereが必要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a consultant.

choices.A: Mr. Lewis, who report we reviewed, will answer questions afterward.
choices.B: Mr. Lewis, whose report we reviewed, will answer questions afterward.
choices.C: Mr. Lewis, that report we reviewed, will answer questions afterward.
choices.D: Mr. Lewis whose report, we reviewed will answer questions afterward.

questions.translationJa: 報告書を確認したルイスさんが、その後質問に答えます。
questions.explanationJa: reportがMr. Lewisの所有物なのでwhoseを使い、補足部分をカンマで囲みます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a factory tour.

choices.A: The factory where the components are assembled offers tours on Fridays.
choices.B: The factory which the components are assembled offers tours on Fridays.
choices.C: The factory where the components are assembled there offers tours on Fridays.
choices.D: The factory whom the components are assembled offers tours on Fridays.

questions.translationJa: 部品が組み立てられる工場では金曜日に見学ツアーを行っています。
questions.explanationJa: are assembledの場所を表すwhereが必要で、thereは不要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an attached file.

choices.A: The budget spreadsheet, that I revised this morning, is attached.
choices.B: The budget spreadsheet which, I revised this morning is attached.
choices.C: The budget spreadsheet, which I revised it this morning, is attached.
choices.D: The budget spreadsheet, which I revised this morning, is attached.

questions.translationJa: 今朝修正した予算表を添付しています。
questions.explanationJa: カンマ付きの目的格関係節ではwhichを使い、目的語itを重ねません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a reception desk.

choices.A: The desk which visitors collect their badges is near the elevator.
choices.B: The desk where visitors collect their badges there is near the elevator.
choices.C: The desk where visitors collect their badges is near the elevator.
choices.D: The desk who visitors collect their badges is near the elevator.

questions.translationJa: 来訪者がバッジを受け取る受付はエレベーターの近くです。
questions.explanationJa: collectの目的語はbadgesでそろっており、欠けている場所をwhereが補います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence containing a nonessential comment.

choices.A: The main auditorium that seats 500 people, has been reserved.
choices.B: The main auditorium, which seats 500 people, has been reserved.
choices.C: The main auditorium, that seats 500 people, has been reserved.
choices.D: The main auditorium, which it seats 500 people, has been reserved.

questions.translationJa: 500人収容のメイン講堂が予約されています。
questions.explanationJa: 特定済みのmain auditoriumへの補足なので、カンマ＋whichが正しいです。
questions.focus: カンマで追加情報を示す

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a regional manager.

choices.A: Ms. Diallo that joined the company in 2018, now manages three offices.
choices.B: Ms. Diallo, which joined the company in 2018, now manages three offices.
choices.C: Ms. Diallo, who she joined the company in 2018, now manages three offices.
choices.D: Ms. Diallo, who joined the company in 2018, now manages three offices.

questions.translationJa: 2018年に入社したディアロさんは、現在3つの事業所を管理しています。
questions.explanationJa: 人へのカンマ付き注釈にはwhoを使い、主語を重複させません。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Our Tokyo office, which opened in 2015, employs eighty people.”

choices.A: Only the Tokyo office that opened in 2015 employs people.
choices.B: The Tokyo office employs fifteen people and will open soon.
choices.C: Every office except Tokyo opened in 2015.
choices.D: Our Tokyo office opened in 2015, and it employs eighty people.

questions.translationJa: 東京事業所は2015年に開設され、80人を雇用しています。
questions.explanationJa: カンマ付きwhich節は、既に特定された東京事業所への追加情報です。
questions.focus: 非制限節をand節へ言い換える

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “This is the counter where customers return rented devices.”

choices.A: Customers rent this counter with their devices.
choices.B: Customers return rented devices at this counter.
choices.C: The counter returns devices to every customer.
choices.D: Customers may return only the counter, not the devices.

questions.translationJa: 顧客はこの窓口でレンタル機器を返却します。
questions.explanationJa: whereはat this counterという場所情報に相当します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Mr. Patel, who designed the survey, will present the findings.”

choices.A: The person who will present the findings is not Mr. Patel.
choices.B: Mr. Patel will present a survey designed by someone else.
choices.C: Mr. Patel designed the survey, and he will present the findings.
choices.D: Only people named Patel may complete the survey.

questions.translationJa: 調査票を設計したパテルさんが結果を発表します。
questions.explanationJa: who節はMr. Patelについて付け加えた事実で、and he節にできます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The Lakeside Center, where the seminar will take place, has free parking.”

choices.A: The seminar will take place at the Lakeside Center, which has free parking.
choices.B: The Lakeside Center will close its parking area during the seminar.
choices.C: The seminar location has not yet been selected.
choices.D: Only parking staff may enter the Lakeside Center.

questions.translationJa: セミナーは無料駐車場のあるレイクサイドセンターで開かれます。
questions.explanationJa: where節はセミナーの開催場所がLakeside Centerであることを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The copier, which is beside the mailroom, is out of order.”

choices.A: The mailroom copier was moved and repaired.
choices.B: A copier inside the mailroom is available.
choices.C: The copier works only when the mailroom is closed.
choices.D: The copier is beside the mailroom, and it is not working.

questions.translationJa: 郵便室の隣にあるコピー機は故障中です。
questions.explanationJa: which節の位置情報と主節の故障情報を二文相当で保持しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The branch where I met the client closes at six.”

choices.A: The client closed the branch before meeting me.
choices.B: I will meet the client at six outside the branch.
choices.C: I met the client at the branch that closes at six.
choices.D: The branch closes whenever the client arrives.

questions.translationJa: 私が顧客に会った支店は6時に閉まります。
questions.explanationJa: where I met the clientはat the branchでの面会を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Ms. Kim, whose team won the contract, thanked everyone.”

choices.A: Ms. Kim thanked everyone, and her team won the contract.
choices.B: Everyone thanked Ms. Kim for winning the contract alone.
choices.C: Ms. Kim's team lost the contract but thanked everyone.
choices.D: The team thanked only the person whose name was Kim.

questions.translationJa: チームが契約を獲得したキムさんは全員に感謝しました。
questions.explanationJa: whose teamはher teamという所有関係を追加説明しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The archive room, where old contracts are kept, requires a key card.”

choices.A: Old contracts are kept on the key card itself.
choices.B: Old contracts are kept in the archive room, and entry requires a key card.
choices.C: The archive room requires contracts instead of a key card.
choices.D: Anyone may enter the archive room without identification.

questions.translationJa: 古い契約書を保管する資料室への入室にはキーカードが必要です。
questions.explanationJa: whereはin the archive roomを表し、カンマ節は資料室への補足です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The shuttle, which departs every thirty minutes, stops outside Terminal 2.”

choices.A: The shuttle reaches Terminal 2 only once each day.
choices.B: Terminal 2 closes for thirty minutes whenever the shuttle arrives.
choices.C: A different shuttle stops inside Terminal 2 every two hours.
choices.D: The shuttle leaves twice an hour and stops outside Terminal 2.

questions.translationJa: そのシャトルは30分ごとに出発し、第2ターミナルの外に停車します。
questions.explanationJa: which節のevery thirty minutesをtwice an hourと言い換えています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The showroom where the prototype is displayed is open to invited guests.”

choices.A: The prototype is available for purchase by every visitor.
choices.B: The showroom is closed because the prototype was removed.
choices.C: Invited guests may enter the showroom that contains the prototype.
choices.D: Guests must display an invitation inside the prototype.

questions.translationJa: 試作品が展示されているショールームには招待客が入れます。
questions.explanationJa: where節は試作品がそのshowroomに展示されていることを示します。

questions.prompt: Please meet us at the visitor center. It is the building ------- guests receive temporary passes.

choices.A: where
choices.B: which
choices.C: that
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: ビジターセンターでお会いしましょう。そこは来訪者が一時通行証を受け取る建物です。
questions.explanationJa: receiveの目的語はpassesでそろっており、建物内という場所をwhereが示します。

questions.prompt: Mr. Ito will conduct the inspection. He is the engineer, ------- has worked on this system since its installation.

choices.A: that
choices.B: which
choices.C: who
choices.D: whom

questions.translationJa: 伊藤さんが検査を行います。彼は設置時からこのシステムを担当してきた技術者です。
questions.explanationJa: engineerへのカンマ付き補足で、has workedの主語になるwhoを使います。

questions.prompt: We have moved the orientation to Hall B, ------- can accommodate 120 participants. The start time is unchanged.

choices.A: that
choices.B: which
choices.C: where
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: オリエンテーションを120人収容できるBホールへ移しました。開始時刻は変わりません。
questions.explanationJa: Hall Bへの追加情報なので、カンマ後はwhichを使います。

questions.prompt: Your replacement card is ready. Please collect it at the security office ------- employee badges are issued.

choices.A: which
choices.B: that
choices.C: whose
choices.D: where

questions.translationJa: 交換カードの準備ができました。社員証を発行する警備室で受け取ってください。
questions.explanationJa: badges are issuedの場所を示すwhereが適切です。

questions.prompt: The quarterly report, ------- I sent separately this morning, contains the revised forecast. Please use that version.

choices.A: that
choices.B: where
choices.C: which
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: 今朝別送した四半期報告書には修正予測が含まれています。その版を使用してください。
questions.explanationJa: 特定済みreportへの補足で、sentの目的語になるwhichを使います。

questions.prompt: Ms. Alvarez, ------- department organized the event, will distribute the feedback form. Please return it by Friday.

choices.A: who
choices.B: which
choices.C: that
choices.D: whose

questions.translationJa: 部門がイベントを運営したアルバレスさんがアンケートを配布します。金曜日までに返却してください。
questions.explanationJa: departmentの所有者を示すためwhoseを用います。

questions.prompt: The maintenance team has reopened the cafeteria, ------- the ventilation system was repaired yesterday. Normal hours resume today.

choices.A: where
choices.B: which
choices.C: that
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: 換気設備が昨日修理された食堂を保守チームが再開しました。本日から通常営業です。
questions.explanationJa: 食堂内で修理が行われたことを示すwhereです。

questions.prompt: The signed agreement, ------- is stored in the legal department, will be scanned this afternoon. A copy will follow.

choices.A: that
choices.B: which
choices.C: where
choices.D: whom

questions.translationJa: 法務部に保管されている署名済み契約書は今日の午後にスキャンされます。写しは後ほど送ります。
questions.explanationJa: カンマ付きでagreementへの補足を加え、is storedの主語になるwhichを使います。

questions.prompt: The new distribution center is in Kariya. It is the site ------- all domestic orders will be packed from October.

choices.A: where
choices.B: which
choices.C: that
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: 新しい配送センターは刈谷にあります。10月から国内注文をすべて梱包する拠点です。
questions.explanationJa: orders will be packedという出来事の場所をwhereが示します。

questions.prompt: Dr. Morgan, ------- will review the safety data, joins the call at two. Please send questions in advance.

choices.A: that
choices.B: who
choices.C: which
choices.D: whom

questions.translationJa: 安全データを確認するモーガン博士は2時の電話会議に参加します。質問は事前に送ってください。
questions.explanationJa: 人物へのカンマ付き補足で、will reviewの主語になるwhoが必要です。
